headline: TierKV combines predictive KV-cache compression and flash tiers for mobile LLM inference
summary: Shu et al. describe TierKV, an accepted EuroSys 2027 system that predicts cache demand from prefill states and jointly places tokens in exact, low-rank and flash-offloaded tiers. In the authors’ eight-model, three-mobile-SoC evaluation, it reduced RAM-resident KV cache by 12.5–34% and improved prefill throughput by up to 17.6× versus MNN-LLM; the largest speedup is baseline-specific. Average end-to-end speedup was 1.10× versus llama.cpp, while decoding throughput fell in some cases from SVD reconstruction. These are paper-reported results; no independent reproduction was performed.
